hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card UI with muted pastel circles shows some design intent, but the dark edge bundles overwhelm the hierarchy encoding, the circle pack is clipped at the bottom edge, and the overall palette and typography are competent-but-generic.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for radius/size encoding, data-driven domain via d3.extent, proper key functions on both nodes and links, and scaleSqrt on the sunburst radial scale — no bar/area baseline issues since layout types don't require zero baseline.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire full 1500ms updateLayout() transitions on every input event without debounce; the tension-slider guard checks for a '.transitioning' CSS class that is never applied (always a no-op); switching to Force layout skips creating svg.transition() so any in-flight tween is never interrupted, letting the force simulation fight an active tween for transform control; and drag interactions have no pointer/touch event filtering.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: 200 nodes and 300 edges at 8% curve tension collapse into an unreadable central hairball that overwhelms the otherwise clear cluster separation provided by the circle-pack color encoding.
